ctx.x: Shadow joined him in '50. This first drummer that he had when he came back from Paris didn't pan out. His name was Harold Wang. He was half Chinese and Negro. And we called him Chink. But he wanted to play with sticks, and by playing with Erroll Garner, he thought he was a star, you know, and he was going to be heard, and he was drowning Erroll out with sticks, you know. So at this time, Erroll asked me, he said, 'Man, can't you do something with him?' I said, 'No, I can't do anything with him. This is your…
Erroll went to Paris in, what, late '49?
